title: Stop cleanup without an effective policy

context.hint: Check that a background cleanup service applies the current retention policy to each unit of work.
context.surface: A background job deletes expired records in batches under a configurable retention policy.
assumptions: Authorized administrators can change or disable the effective retention policy.
Use synthetic records, a controlled clock and an in-memory storage double.

review.invariant: Cleanup performs no deletion when the record owner is absent or has no effective retention policy.
review.verification: Test a missing owner and a disabled policy independently with a recording storage double. Assert zero deletion calls and verify that cleanup still runs under a valid, unchanged policy.

source_observation.summary: The targeted checks for absent owners and disabled policies passed after the guard was added. The unchanged-policy control continued to pass.
